title: Corporate teaching lesson, topic pending
readiness: Structural planning scaffold only. Not approved for scripting or production. All instructional slots below are unresolved, not learner-facing content. F1-F8 document input limitations and must never become lesson content.
performance: Provisional: make and justify the approved workplace choice in the approved running situation, using the approved governing criterion. The topic, action, success criterion and correct reasoning are not supplied or verified.

audience.assumed_prior: Unknown. Do not assume topic familiarity, policy knowledge or role-specific experience.
audience.why: Corporate employees are the supplied audience. Practitioner is a provisional design classification, not a verified measure of expertise.
audience.motivation: Practical workplace relevance is inferred in the brief, not confirmed by audience research.
audience.context: Employee roles, recurring decision, viewing context and relevant experience remain unverified.
audience.branching_rule: Confirm relevant prior knowledge before release. Retain necessary pre-training for unfamiliar learners; shorten it for experienced learners without deleting the underlying explanation.

genre_status: Unverified structural placeholder. No substantive material exists from which to classify the lesson. Reclassify after approval; numerical content must not be assumed.

strategy.name: scenario_led
strategy.rationale: The brief provisionally calls for one sustained workplace dilemma, a consequential choice and a return to that dilemma. This supports a provisional scenario-led structure, but no instructional source shape or suitable scenario has been verified.
strategy.signature_move: Show the approved dilemma, surface the choice, apply the approved criterion, inspect the relevant condition, ask for a decision, reveal supported reasoning.
strategy.status: Provisional until the topic and approved account establish that decision-based instruction is appropriate.

misconception_requirements.reason: No topic-specific misconception is established by the supplied administrative knowledge sheet.
misconception_requirements.required_before_release: Approve a belief, why it is tempting, the evidence that breaks it and the section that refutes it. Do not treat missing inputs or not_claimed entries as employee misconceptions.

hook.sketch: [Pending approval: ask which action resolves the approved workplace dilemma and what supports that choice.]
hook.on_screen_essence: Which action resolves this workplace dilemma?
hook.status: Unwritten. The bracketed text specifies a function, not publishable narration.
hook.grounding: Requires an approved workplace situation and supported resolution. Any fictional details must be explicitly introduced with imagine or say.

arc.promise: Pending approval: specify the workplace action and success criterion the viewer will demonstrate in the running dilemma. Do not turn the provisional outcome into a verified promise.
arc.bridge_from_prior: Pending confirmation of relevant experience: prompt recollection of the viewer's existing approach to this same kind of decision, then connect it to the approved distinction. Never supply an assumed belief on the viewer's behalf.

sections.goal: the viewer can explain the approved governing distinction in the approved workplace situation
concepts: [Only the prerequisite terms needed to use that distinction]
sections.teaching_move: Open the approved running dilemma, establish the decision stakes and pre-train only necessary terms. Present the distinction through the situation rather than opening with a definition or agenda.
sections.visual_change: Once approved, move from the unresolved situation to a view highlighting the decision-relevant feature. Do not depict an unverified consequence.
sections.content_required: Confirmed topic, action, situation, prerequisite terms and governing distinction.
sections.recap_content: Reserved for the approved distinction expressed through the running case, not a generic slogan.

sections.goal: the viewer can apply the approved decision criterion to the same workplace situation
sections.teaching_move: Work through the same situation with the criterion visible. The mentor models how the relevant information supports the choice, including the reason for each step.
sections.visual_change: Highlight the approved evidence as it is used, then update the displayed candidate choice only when the supported reasoning warrants it.
sections.content_required: Approved criterion, evidence and worked reasoning. No workplace rule may be inferred from fictional details.
sections.recap_content: Reserved for the approved evidence-to-choice relationship.
sections.mental_job: Invite the viewer to track which part of the approved case supports each step, without stopping playback.

sections.goal: the viewer can distinguish the approved relevant condition from the approved misleading cue in the same workplace situation
concepts: [Approved tempting cue or misconception, if established by the grounding account]
sections.teaching_move: Fade the mentor's reasoning while keeping the same case visible. Contrast the approved relevant condition with the approved tempting cue, then use evidence to explain why the cue does not settle the choice.
sections.visual_change: Shift emphasis between the same case's approved condition and cue. Show what changes in the reasoning when the relevant condition is attended to; do not invent outcome differences.
sections.content_required: Verified condition, cue and refutation. If the source contains no such distinction, return this scaffold for redesign rather than manufacture one.
sections.recap_content: Reserved for the supported reason the relevant condition governs the decision.
sections.mental_job: Ask the viewer to identify the decisive condition before the mentor supplies the supported explanation, without a forced pause.

sections.goal: the viewer can choose the approved workplace action using the established criterion and condition
concepts: [Approved conditions for transferring this reasoning to the viewer's work]
sections.teaching_move: Return to the original dilemma with mentor support withdrawn. Reserve a decision-and-justification check, then resolve the dilemma using approved reasoning. Finish with a quiet transfer reflection rather than another new example.
sections.visual_change: After the eventual decision reveal, replace the unresolved choice state with the approved resolved state. Settle on a sparse image of the same situation; animate no unsupported consequences.
sections.content_required: Approved response, one supported tempting wrong belief, answer explanation, resolution and applicability conditions.
sections.recap_content: Reserved for one concise, source-supported criterion the screen can carry.
sections.energy_rationale: Quiet independent reflection and closure, not heightened character performance or additional information.

decision_check.location: Within sec4, after sec3 has taught the decisive condition.
decision_check.question: Not written. Requires the approved consequential workplace choice and a request for its justification.
decision_check.options: Not written. Reserve the supported answer and one source-supported tempting wrong belief.
decision_check.release_rule: Do not generate or present the quiz until its question, options, answer, tempting wrong and reasoning are approved. Then use separate question and reveal scenes, a genuine silent pause and no premature answer.
decision_check.feedback_rule: Explain the supported answer and why the single tempting wrong belief fails. Keep the takeaway short enough for its screen.

arc.payoff: Unwritten. Return to the exact opening situation and show the approved choice resolving it under the approved criterion and condition. Answer the hook's question explicitly, without implying any unverified policy or consequence.

practice_ladder.task: Observe the mentor applying the approved criterion to the running situation.
practice_ladder.support: Criterion, relevant case evidence and full supported reasoning remain visible.
practice_ladder.success_criterion: Pending approved action and criterion; do not score or claim achievement.

practice_ladder.task: Distinguish the decisive approved condition from the approved tempting cue in the same situation.
practice_ladder.support: Keep the case and criterion visible; withhold the next reasoning step until the viewer has considered it.
practice_ladder.feedback: Reveal only source-supported reasoning and refutation.

practice_ladder.task: Choose and justify the action in the opening dilemma before the supported response is revealed.
practice_ladder.support: Case evidence remains visible; the mentor no longer supplies the reasoning before the choice.
practice_ladder.feedback: Reserved in arc.decision_check; no response is currently verified.
practice_ladder.success_criterion: Pending requester approval of the correct action, rationale and applicability conditions.

pacing.duration_status: Imagine a 240-second planning envelope at 145 words per minute. These are illustrative design settings, not a supplied runtime, source fact or verified feasibility estimate. Do not commission a script against this envelope before approval.
slowdown_at: sec3: provisional reservation for the distinction between the governing condition and tempting cue. Its actual difficulty is unverified.

recall_moments.prompt: [Recall the approved criterion just applied to this same situation.]
recall_moments.retrieval_target: The criterion taught and demonstrated in sec2.
recall_moments.screen_support: Keep only the approved criterion's short label beside the running case.
recall_moments.reveal: Return to the approved criterion with the case evidence already shown in sec2; no new facts.
recall_moments.delivery: Spoken callback, not a stopping check.

pacing.stopping_check_budget: No active stopping checks exist while blocked. The reserved decision quiz would be the only stopping check within the imagined envelope.
pacing.mental_job_cadence: Once content and runtime are approved, distribute the tracked evidence, faded reasoning, recall callback and independent decision across the compact lesson. Exact timings remain unverified.
pacing.timing_verification: No narration, pause length or scene timings have been verified.

transfer_tasks.task: Identify the next relevant decision in your own work, check whether the approved applicability conditions hold, and use the approved criterion to choose and justify the action.
transfer_tasks.deliverable: A workplace choice with its supporting case evidence and an applicability check, once those requirements are confirmed.
transfer_tasks.boundary: No separate instructional example, invented local policy or unsupported generalisation. If applicability cannot be established, consult the requester-approved authority or reference, which is not yet supplied.
transfer_tasks.success_criterion: Pending approval; no performance assessment is currently possible.

presentation_contract.primary: Straightforward illustrated story-cartoon treatment with one sustained adult workplace situation.
presentation_contract.presenter: Requested woman presenter, supportive and subordinate to the viewer's reasoning.
presentation_contract.voice: Warm, concise mentor speaking as a capable colleague. No schoolroom language, juvenile praise or patronising authority.
presentation_contract.captions: Include readable captions. Keep other text to essential labels and avoid competing paragraph text or decorative motion.
presentation_contract.alternatives: Retain richer character performance as an optional alternative, not a replacement. Conventional explanatory presentation remains valid; the requested cartoon treatment does not establish superior learning.
presentation_contract.production_release: Do not write instructional narration, invented dialogue, topic claims or answer reveals while blocked.

framework_audit.status: Prospective field map, not a claim that instruction exists or has been validated.

gagne.objective: arc.promise and performance, blocked by the missing action and success criterion.

gagne.practice: practice_ladder[stage=faded], practice_ladder[stage=independent] and pacing.recall_moments, templates only.
gagne.feedback: arc.decision_check.feedback_rule and practice_ladder feedback, blocked by missing response evidence.
gagne.assess: arc.decision_check, reserved but not executable or verified.

merrill.problem_centred: arc.hook and the same case across sec1-sec4, pending an approved workplace problem.
merrill.demonstration: sec2.teaching_move and practice_ladder[stage=worked], pending source-supported application.
merrill.application: sec3.teaching_move and practice_ladder[stage=independent], pending approved tasks and answers.
merrill.integration: transfer_tasks and arc.payoff, pending approved real-work scope.
merrill.verification: All five have reserved locations. None is claimed to be implemented; scripting remains blocked.

mayer.coherence: presentation_contract.primary and sec1.teaching_move: retain only story details necessary for the approved decision.
mayer.signalling: sec2.visual_change and pacing.slowdown_at: highlight evidence and the decisive condition when established.
mayer.redundancy: presentation_contract.captions: captions provide access; other screen text stays minimal rather than duplicating narration in additional blocks.
mayer.contiguity: pacing.recall_moments.screen_support and sec2.visual_change: place labels next to their evidence as it is discussed.
mayer.segmenting: arc.sections: prerequisite distinction, supported application, condition analysis, independent choice and closure.
mayer.pre_training: sec1.concepts and teaching_move: establish only terms required before applying the criterion.

arcs.attention: arc.hook reserves a genuine dilemma, not a definition, agenda or invented fact.
arcs.relevance: performance and transfer_tasks reserve a work-relevant action; actual relevance is not yet verified.
arcs.confidence: practice_ladder reduces support from worked to faded to independent; success criteria await approval.
arcs.satisfaction: arc.payoff returns to the same situation and resolves it with tested reasoning, once that resolution is supported.

flags: BLOCKED-CONTENT: F1, F3 and F5 establish that topic, topic-specific action and instructional source are missing. No instructional claims have been written or verified.
OUTCOME-PROVISIONAL: F2. Performance, goals and success criteria are structural placeholders, not approved promises.
PRIOR-UNKNOWN: F4. Audience expertise and starting approach are not verified.
HOOK-NEEDS-FACT: F6. No approved dilemma or supported resolution exists. The hook is unwritten.
CHECK-BLOCKED: F7. No correct response is supplied. The reserved quiz is not an active recall moment; do not fabricate its answer or tempting wrong.
NO-INVENTED-POLICY: F8. Illustrative detail cannot establish a workplace rule, evidence or correct answer.
MISCONCEPTION-PENDING: No topic misconception is approved. The empty misconceptions array is intentional.
DURATION-MISMATCH: No numeric duration was supplied. Imagine the 240-second envelope only as a provisional planning assumption; obtain approval and verify feasibility before scripting.
GENRE-UNVERIFIED: Mixed is a required schema placeholder, not a classification based on instructional content. Reassess when material exists.
SOURCE-AUDIT: F1-F8 are administrative input limitations only. They are not lesson concepts, hook evidence or quiz answers.
NOT-VERIFIED: No external research, topic claims, policy, scenario, answer, performance criterion, applicability boundary, narration or production timing has been verified.
RELEASE-HOLD: This artifact defines a prospective teaching structure only. Topic, outcome, grounding material and audience experience must be confirmed before instructional writing begins.
